name: Bug report
about: Report a bug to help improve ARIA
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Bug description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce
```bash
# e.g.
python simulation/run_simulation.py --duration 60
```

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happened. Include error messages and tracebacks.

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11 / Ubuntu 22.04]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.11.9] (`python --version`)
- GPU: [e.g. RTX 3060 12GB / none]
- Installed packages: `pip list` output (or the relevant subset)

## Logs & outputs
- Contents of `output/logs/aria_simulation.log` (if the simulation ran)
- Any generated figures that look wrong (attach them)

## Additional context
Anything else that might help (recent changes, custom commands, etc.).
